source_documents.title: Tuning the dual emission of keto/enol forms of excited-state intramolecular proton transfer (ESIPT) emitters via intramolecular charge transfer (ICT)

reference_evidence_units.quote: Both 6c and 6d in toluene exhibit two emission bands, ranging from 400 nm to 500 nm and from 500 nm to 650 nm
reference_evidence_units.subject: 6c and 6d
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source records dual bands and assigns them to enol and keto emission.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Similar excitation spectra are reported in SI but those underlying traces are unavailable.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the energy differences both S1(enol)→TS* and S1(keto)→TS* are small
reference_evidence_units.subject: 6c
reference_evidence_units.statement: Small barriers in both directions are used to support excited-state enol/keto balance.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This is computed feasibility, not direct time-resolved observation of equilibrium.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The large solvatochromic shift indicates that the enol-form emissions of 6a and 6c are of typical ICT characters
reference_evidence_units.subject: 6a and 6c
reference_evidence_units.statement: The enol form has CT/HLCT character in the authors' account.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The paper explicitly does not assign the keto form the same ICT/HLCT character.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Hence, both 6a and 6c do not possess thermally activated delayed fluorescence (TADF) characteristics
reference_evidence_units.subject: 6a and 6c
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Temperature and oxygen-dependent PL reported in the main text with SI traces.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source rejects TADF in these emitters.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Do not treat this as rejection of all high-state triplet mechanisms.

reference_evidence_units.quote: indicating that the RISC from T3 (enol) to S1 (enol) may take place
reference_evidence_units.subject: 6c
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Calculated excited-state energies, Figure 7b and OLED utilization discussion.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source tentatively proposes high-state RISC.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The word may matters: a computed energy match does not demonstrate population transfer.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Enol-state HLCT supports the source's substituent and emission interpretation.

reference_mechanisms.label: ESIPT_PT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Dual enol/keto emission and small computed barriers motivate the central ESIPT account.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The source explicitly models competing emissive tautomers; this overlaps ESIPT and is not an independent demonstrated cause.

reference_mechanisms.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Tentative high-state RISC is kept separate from the explicitly rejected TADF mechanism.
